task: D9.16 quote-request page uses Composite Manager /v1/overview as its only business read and fails closed without legacy fallback
decision: The quote-request GET is manager-owned. Flask now selects one manager overview arbitragePath by pair and maps route symbols, addresses, PoolKey/pool IDs, QuoteInputs, Review signed PnL, versions and data quality into the existing quote request DTO as quoteMode=manager_overview_projection. The route no longer invokes legacy bootstrap, legacy surface payload, legacy quote-route payload or observation overview. Missing manager paths return HTTP 404 manager_request_not_found; manager unavailability, malformed overview hierarchy or invalid chain scope return HTTP 503 manager_read_failed. Both error shapes keep dataSource=manager and managerDetail with no legacy fallback.
